title: Bharata and his army reach Chitrakuta mountain
introduction: Travelling for a long time, Bharata and his army reach Chitrakuta mountain. Bharata Chitrakuta mountain. Bharata appreciates the beauty of that place and identifies it as an abode of ascetics. He instructs his soldiers to explore the woods and find out where Rama and Lakshmana are living. Valiant men penetrate into the forest and pursuing their search, they observe a plume of smoke rising at some distance and concluding the site to be the hermitage of Rama. Bharata commands his army to halt and decides to walk with Sumantra and Dhriti his spiritual preceptor to Rama's hermitage.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रिनवतितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 93rd Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तया महत्या यायिन्या ध्वजिन्या वन वासिनः |
अर्दिता यूथपा मत्ताः सयूथाः सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः
verses.iast:
tayā mahatyā yāyinyā dhvajinyā vana vāsinaḥ |
arditā yūthapā mattāḥ sayūthāḥ sampradudruvuḥ
verses.translation: Seeing that large army on the march, the herds of beasts with their leaders, the denizens of the woods were frightened and ran away together.

glosses.meaning: leaders of the herds of beasts

verses.devanagari:
ऋक्षाः पृषत सम्घाः च रुरवः च समन्ततः |
दृश्यन्ते वन राजीषु गिरिषु अपि नदीषु च
verses.iast:
ṛkṣāḥ pṛṣata samghāḥ ca ruravaḥ ca samantataḥ |
dṛśyante vana rājīṣu giriṣu api nadīṣu ca
verses.translation: Bears, dappled deer and antelopes could be seen every where, on the tracks of the forest, on the hills and by the rivers.

glosses.meaning: on the tracks of the forest

verses.devanagari:
स सम्प्रतस्थे धर्म आत्मा प्रीतो दशरथ आत्मजः |
वृतो महत्या नादिन्या सेनया चतुर् अन्गया
verses.iast:
sa sampratasthe dharma ātmā prīto daśaratha ātmajaḥ |
vṛto mahatyā nādinyā senayā catur angayā
verses.translation: That pious minded Bharata gracefully marched ahead, surrounded by that clamorous army of four divisions.

verses.devanagari:
सागर ओघ निभा सेना भरतस्य महात्मनः |
महीम् संचादयाम् आस प्रावृषि द्याम् इव अम्बुदः
verses.iast:
sāgara ogha nibhā senā bharatasya mahātmanaḥ |
mahīm saṃcādayām āsa prāvṛṣi dyām iva ambudaḥ
verses.translation: The army, of the magnanimous Bharata, which resembled the high tide of an ocean, covered the earth as clouds cover the sky in a rainy season.

glosses.meaning: which resembled the high tide of an ocean

verses.devanagari:
तुरम्ग ओघैर् अवतता वारणैः च महा जवैः |
अनालक्ष्या चिरम् कालम् तस्मिन् काले बभूव भूः
verses.iast:
turamga oghair avatatā vāraṇaiḥ ca mahā javaiḥ |
anālakṣyā ciram kālam tasmin kāle babhūva bhūḥ
verses.translation: Submerged by the waves of horses and elephants of great speed at that time, the earth became invisible for a long time.

verses.devanagari:
स यात्वा दूरम् अध्वानम् सुपरिश्रान्त वाहनः |
उवाच भरतः श्रीमान् वसिष्ठम् मन्त्रिणाम् वरम्
verses.iast:
sa yātvā dūram adhvānam supariśrānta vāhanaḥ |
uvāca bharataḥ śrīmān vasiṣṭham mantriṇām varam
verses.translation: Having travelled for a long distance, that glorious Bharata, whose animals were now fully exhausted, said to Vasishta, the most segaceios of his counsellors (as follows)

verses.devanagari:
यादृशम् लक्ष्यते रूपम् यथा चैव श्रुतम् मया |
व्यक्तम् प्राप्ताः स्म तम् देशम् भरद्वाजो यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
yādṛśam lakṣyate rūpam yathā caiva śrutam mayā |
vyaktam prāptāḥ sma tam deśam bharadvājo yam abravīt
verses.translation: "Looking at the features of the pace and from what has been heard by me, it is clear that we reached that area of which Bharadwaja spoke."

verses.devanagari:
अयम् गिरिः चित्र कूटः तथा मन्दाकिनी नदी |
एतत् प्रकाशते दूरान् नील मेघ निभम् वनम्
verses.iast:
ayam giriḥ citra kūṭaḥ tathā mandākinī nadī |
etat prakāśate dūrān nīla megha nibham vanam
verses.translation: "This mountain is Chitrakuta. This river is Mandakini. This forest is appearing like a blue cloud from a distance."

verses.devanagari:
गिरेः सानूनि रम्याणि चित्र कूटस्य सम्प्रति |
वारणैर् अवमृद्यन्ते मामकैः पर्वत उपमैः
verses.iast:
gireḥ sānūni ramyāṇi citra kūṭasya samprati |
vāraṇair avamṛdyante māmakaiḥ parvata upamaiḥ
verses.translation: "By my elephants appearing themselves like mountains, the lovely peaks of Chitrakuta mountain are being trampled."

verses.devanagari:
मुन्चन्ति कुसुमान्य् एते नगाः पर्वत सानुषु |
नीला इव आतप अपाये तोयम् तोय धरा घनाः
verses.iast:
muncanti kusumāny ete nagāḥ parvata sānuṣu |
nīlā iva ātapa apāye toyam toya dharā ghanāḥ
verses.translation: "These trees on the peaks of the mountain are shedding flowers, as black and intense clouds shower water in a rainy season."

glosses.meaning: on the peaks of the mountain

verses.devanagari:
किन्नर आचरित उद्देशम् पश्य शत्रुघ्न पर्वतम् |
हयैः समन्ताद् आकीर्णम् मकरैर् इव सागरम्
verses.iast:
kinnara ācarita uddeśam paśya śatrughna parvatam |
hayaiḥ samantād ākīrṇam makarair iva sāgaram
verses.translation: "Behold, O Shatrughna, this mountain, (hitherto) frequented by Kinnaras, now teaming with horses on every side, as a sea is infested by allegators."

verses.devanagari:
एते मृग गणा भान्ति शीघ्र वेगाः प्रचोदिताः |
वायु प्रविद्धाः शरदि मेघ राज्य इव अम्बरे
verses.iast:
ete mṛga gaṇā bhānti śīghra vegāḥ pracoditāḥ |
vāyu praviddhāḥ śaradi megha rājya iva ambare
verses.translation: "These herds of antelopes, having a rapid speed, as urged forward (by the troops) appear like a mass of clouds driven by the wind in the sky in antumn."

verses.devanagari:
कुर्वन्ति कुसुम आपीडान् शिरह्सु सुरभीन् अमी |
मेघ प्रकाशैः फलकैर् दाक्षिणात्या यथा नराः
verses.iast:
kurvanti kusuma āpīḍān śirahsu surabhīn amī |
megha prakāśaiḥ phalakair dākṣiṇātyā yathā narāḥ
verses.translation: "Those tree, with their leaves in multitude dazzling, crowned with fragrant chaplets of flowers, resemble the people of the south."

verses.devanagari:
निष्कूजम् इव भूत्वा इदम् वनम् घोर प्रदर्शनम् |
अयोध्या इव जन आकीर्णा सम्प्रति प्रतिभाति मा
verses.iast:
niṣkūjam iva bhūtvā idam vanam ghora pradarśanam |
ayodhyā iva jana ākīrṇā samprati pratibhāti mā
verses.translation: "This forest, which was silent and wore a terrifying look till now, appears to me like Ayodhya, swarning with people."

glosses.meaning: and wore a terrifying look (till now)

verses.devanagari:
खुरैर् उदीरितो रेणुर् दिवम् प्रग्च्छाद्य तिष्ठति |
तम् वहत्य् अनिलः शीघ्रम् कुर्वन्न् इव मम प्रियम्
verses.iast:
khurair udīrito reṇur divam pragcchādya tiṣṭhati |
tam vahaty anilaḥ śīghram kurvann iva mama priyam
verses.translation: "The dust raised from the hooves of the horses blots out the heavens, but the wind carries it away immediately as if to give me pleasure."

glosses.meaning: from the hooves of the horses

verses.devanagari:
स्यन्दनामः तुरग उपेतान् सूत मुख्यैर् अधिष्ठितान् |
एतान् सम्पततः शीघ्रम् पश्य शत्रुघ्न कानने
verses.iast:
syandanāmḥ turaga upetān sūta mukhyair adhiṣṭhitān |
etān sampatataḥ śīghram paśya śatrughna kānane
verses.translation: "Behold, O Shatrughna, these chariots yoked with horses and mounted by the chief charioteers are rushing together rapidly in the forest."

verses.devanagari:
एतान् वित्रासितान् पश्य बर्हिणः प्रिय दर्शनान् |
एतम् आविशतः शैलम् अधिवासम् पतत्रिणाम्
verses.iast:
etān vitrāsitān paśya barhiṇaḥ priya darśanān |
etam āviśataḥ śailam adhivāsam patatriṇām
verses.translation: "Behold these peacocks and birds, which are pleasant to the sight, are frightened and are entering their dwelling places hastily."

glosses.meaning: which are pleasant to the sight

verses.devanagari:
अतिमात्रम् अयम् देशो मनोज्नः प्रतिभाति मा |
तापसानाम् निवासो अयम् व्यक्तम् स्वर्ग पथो यथा
verses.iast:
atimātram ayam deśo manojnaḥ pratibhāti mā |
tāpasānām nivāso ayam vyaktam svarga patho yathā
verses.translation: "This place to me is appearing very much lovely. Resembling in every way like a threshold of heaven, it is clearly an abode of ascetics."

glosses.meaning: Resembling in every way like a threshold of heaven

verses.devanagari:
मृगा मृगीभिः सहिता बहवः पृषता वने |
मनोज्न रूपा लक्ष्यन्ते कुसुमैर् इव चित्रितः
verses.iast:
mṛgā mṛgībhiḥ sahitā bahavaḥ pṛṣatā vane |
manojna rūpā lakṣyante kusumair iva citritaḥ
verses.translation: "In this forest, many dappled deer with their hinds, endowed with enchanting forms, are seen as if studded with flowers."

verses.devanagari:
साधु सैन्याः प्रतिष्ठन्ताम् विचिन्वन्तु च काननम् |
यथा तौ पुरुष व्याघ्रौ दृश्येते राम लक्ष्मणौ
verses.iast:
sādhu sainyāḥ pratiṣṭhantām vicinvantu ca kānanam |
yathā tau puruṣa vyāghrau dṛśyete rāma lakṣmaṇau
verses.translation: "Let the soldiers proceed quickly to explore the woods to find those tigers among men, Rama and Lakshamana."

verses.devanagari:
भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा पुरुषाः शस्त्र पाणयः |
विविशुः तद् वनम् शूरा धूमम् च ददृशुः ततः
verses.iast:
bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā puruṣāḥ śastra pāṇayaḥ |
viviśuḥ tad vanam śūrā dhūmam ca dadṛśuḥ tataḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Bharata, valiant men wearing weapons in their hands, penetrated into the forest suddenly they observed a plume of smoke rising.

verses.devanagari:
ते समालोक्य धूम अग्रम् ऊचुर् भरतम् आगताः |
न अमनुष्ये भवत्य् अग्निर् व्यक्तम् अत्र एव राघवौ
verses.iast:
te samālokya dhūma agram ūcur bharatam āgatāḥ |
na amanuṣye bhavaty agnir vyaktam atra eva rāghavau
verses.translation: Seeing that spiral of smoke, they returned to bharata and said; "There can be no fire in a deserted place. Assuredly, Rama and Lakshmana are there."

verses.devanagari:
अथ न अत्र नर व्याघ्रौ राज पुत्रौ परम् तपौ |
अन्ये राम उपमाः सन्ति व्यक्तम् अत्र तपस्विनः
verses.iast:
atha na atra nara vyāghrau rāja putrau param tapau |
anye rāma upamāḥ santi vyaktam atra tapasvinaḥ
verses.translation: "If it be not those two tigers among men, the two princes, the scourger of their foes here, obviously there are other ascetics like Rama here."

verses.devanagari:
तत् श्रुत्वा भरतः तेषाम् वचनम् साधु सम्मतम् |
सैन्यान् उवाच सर्वामः तान् अमित्र बल मर्दनः
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā bharataḥ teṣām vacanam sādhu sammatam |
sainyān uvāca sarvāmḥ tān amitra bala mardanaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing those words concurred even by pious men, Bharata the destroyer of enemy's forces, spoke to the entire army (as follows)

glosses.meaning: sarvaan sainyaan = to that entire army (as follows)

verses.devanagari:
यत् ता भवन्तः तिष्ठन्तु न इतो गन्तव्यम् अग्रतः |
अहम् एव गमिष्यामि सुमन्त्रो गुरुर् एव च
verses.iast:
yat tā bhavantaḥ tiṣṭhantu na ito gantavyam agrataḥ |
aham eva gamiṣyāmi sumantro gurur eva ca
verses.translation: "You stay here vigilantly. Do no proceed any further. I alone will go along with Sumantra and also Dhriti, my spiritual preceptor."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ताः ततः सर्वे तत्र तस्थुः समन्ततः |
भरतो यत्र धूम अग्रम् तत्र दृष्टिम् समादधत्
verses.iast:
evam uktāḥ tataḥ sarve tatra tasthuḥ samantataḥ |
bharato yatra dhūma agram tatra dṛṣṭim samādadhat
verses.translation: On this command, all the troops halted there and Bharat with his gaze fixed on the column of smoke, went forward.

verses.devanagari:
व्यवस्थिता या भरतेन सा चमूर् |
निरीक्षमाणा अपि च धूमम् अग्रतः |
बभूव हृष्टा नचिरेण जानती |
प्रियस्य रामस्य समागमम् तदा
verses.iast:
vyavasthitā yā bharatena sā camūr |
nirīkṣamāṇā api ca dhūmam agrataḥ |
babhūva hṛṣṭā nacireṇa jānatī |
priyasya rāmasya samāgamam tadā
verses.translation: The army, which was held up there by Bharata, eventhough perceiving the place ahead, felt rejoiced in the thought of meeting their beloved Rama soon.

glosses.meaning: even though perceiving bhuumi = the place
